title: Injection Mold/ Utility Operator
description:
Job Title: Injection Mold/ Utility Operator - 25-00913

Overview:
This is a manufacturing company that specializes in injection molding such as toolbox, heavy truck, heating and cooling identification and Point of Purchase displays.

Available Shifts:
1st Shift: 6am - 4:30pm
Monday-Thursday, no Fridays and no weekends!

Pay Rate:
$20 /hr.

Work environment:
It is a small locally owned and operated business. It can get hot in the summer and cold in the winter. Can be a dirty environment in plastics.

Job Description:
An Injection Molding Material Handler/Utility Operator is responsible for safely and efficiently preparing and mixing, moving, and distributing materials within an injection molding facility. This role ensures a smooth production process by delivering the correct materials to injection molding machines, helping to maintain inventory, and adhering to safety and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities:
Material Handling:
Transporting raw materials (like plastic resins, colorants, and additives) to and from storage and molding machines.
Machine Preparation:
Loading hoppers and dryers, setting up material handling equipment (blenders, dryers, vacuum loaders), and ensuring proper material flow to the machines.
Inventory Management:
Maintaining accurate records of material usage, performing cycle counts, and assisting with inventory counts.
Equipment Operation:
Safely operating forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment.
Quality Control:
Inspecting materials for quality and ensuring they meet production standards.
Documentation and Communication:
Properly labeling and storing materials, documenting material usage, and communicating with machine operators, supervisors, and quality personnel.
Housekeeping and Safety:
Maintaining a clean and organized work area, adhering to safety guidelines, and following company policies and procedures.

Requirements:
  • Physical Ability: Ability to lift and carry materials, stand for extended periods, and work in a manufacturing environment. The candidate must be able to climb short ladders (4-5 stairs), read schedules and labels to determine proper supplies, operate an electronic scale, move heavy cartons and barrels ranging from 50 – 100 lbs using a 2 wheel cart, record counts, do simple math including addition, subtracting and ratios, and the ability to read and understand any potential health hazards using plastic resins.
  • Technical Skills: Basic understanding of resins, additives, and material drying processes.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong organizational and record-keeping skills.
  • Communication Skills: Ability to communicate effectively with team members.

Benefits:

description:

This is a direct-hire 1 st Shift opportunity that will pay up to $40/hr. and includes excellent benefits starting on day one. ***This is a Direct Hire opportunity! Never go through a temp-to-hire process. If selected, day ONE you are this company's employee!***
The Maintenance Engineer Technician is an elevated technical role focused on ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operations by maintaining and troubleshooting advanced production equipment, including automated systems and robotics. This new position is key to upgrading the company's maintenance skill set to handle incoming new technology.
Job Responsibilities
  • Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, robotic, and automated systems, utilizing PLCs, ladder logic, and HMIs to resolve faults.
  • Maintain and support automated production equipment such as robotics, conveyors, sensors, actuators, and control systems.
  • Maintain air compressors, lighting, and water systems, while also conducting regular facility inspections.
  • Perform scheduled maintenance on heading, threading, painting, packaging, and automation equipment.
  • Assist with equipment setup, installation, commissioning, and upgrades, following schematics and technical manuals.
  • Support alignment and tooling adjustments during changeovers, and provide operator assistance throughout production runs.
  • Accurately complete work orders, downtime logs, and maintenance records, and communicate repair timelines with production leads.
  • Monitor tool and parts usage, proactively requesting reorders to prevent downtime.
  • Collaborate with production, engineering, and quality teams, and train operators in basic troubleshooting and equipment maintenance.
  • Engage in root cause analysis and contribute to ongoing equipment performance enhancements.
  • Work independently without direct supervision, especially on back shifts, demonstrating a high level of maturity and the ability to understand priorities.
  • Adhere to OSHA standards, lockout/tagout procedures, and company safety policies, while actively participating in safety programs, audits, and corrective actions.
Qualifications
  • 3+ years of experience in manufacturing maintenance
  • Strong Electrical Background is required, experience with Control Voltage, HMIs, 24V, and DC Voltage.
  • Proficiency with PLCs, ladder logic, and electrical/control system troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, electrical, and robotic systems
  • Ability to read blueprints, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals.
  • Associate's degree or technical certification in industrial maintenance is preferred.
  • Ability to communicate well, be proactive, demonstrate consistent drive and motivation
What's in it for you?
With about 170 employees across three locations, this client offers the stability and benefits of a global organization with over 30,000 employees, potential for growth and advancement, while maintaining the personal, close-knit environment of a smaller company.
  • Compensation: Up to $40/hr. (based on experience).

title: Supply Chain & Procurement Manager
description:
Supply Chain & Procurement Manager

The Professional & Direct Hire Division of Spherion Mid Ohio is partnered with a small but mighty manufacturing organization in Ashland County, Ohio that has been making major upgrades and investments in its operations. This is an exciting opportunity to step into a role where you are seen, heard, and able to make a big impact on both strategy and daily operations. We are seeking a Supply Chain & Procurement Manager to oversee procurement, materials, and logistics. In this role, you will guide a small team while ensuring smooth operations from sourcing to shipping. The right leader will be both a big-picture thinker and a hands-on problem solver, with strong ERP expertise and a collaborative approach.

What You Bring

• Data driven and analytical mindset with proven process improvement results.

Why You Will Love It Here

title: Self-Perform Themed Project Manager
description:
The Professional Division of Spherion Mid-Ohio is partnered with an established and growing construction company in Lakeland, FL is seeking a Self-Perform Themed Project Manager with pay range $75K-$100K + Bonus based on skill set & experience. Come join their team!

**This is a direct hire opportunity! Never go through a temp-to-hire process. If selected, day ONE you are this companies employee!**

The Themed Project Manager - is responsible for overseeing multiple themed self-perform projects from start to finish. This includes managing job costs, coordinating Client and equipment needs, and handling daily project operations. The role emphasizes man-hour (MH) based production tracking, change management, and generating Monthly Project Status Reports (MPSRs). Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several projects simultaneously are essential.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Review projects with the Estimating Team to understand scope, exclusions, assumptions, and qualifications
  • Collaborate with the Project Executive (PX) to establish and manage project budgets throughout the life cycle
  • Drive project profitability while upholding safety and quality standards
  • Track all change events and submit Change Order Requests (CORs) in a timely manner; maintain a complete Change Order Log
  • Ensure CORs are properly managed to become billable Change Orders (COs)
  • Coordinate equipment resources with Superintendents, Foremen, and the Equipment Manager (owned/rented), ensuring alignment with budget and project needs
  • Prepare and submit submittals/shop drawings per project specifications
  • Submit monthly pay applications and invoices to Owners, CMs, or GCs
  • Generate and present Monthly Project Status Reports (MPSR) to leadership
  • Participate in regular project meetings as required by clients and job needs
  • Ensure completion of field documentation, including daily reports, toolbox talks, job hazard analyses, and other required paperwork
  • Assist with MH and material takeoffs for Change Orders as needed
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management
Qualifications & Skills:
  • High School Diploma or GED required
  • Experience in self-perform trade work is required
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel
  • Willingness to travel to job sites, including overnight stays
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated leadership and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
  • Reliable work ethic and ability to follow written and verbal instructions
Preferred Skills but not required – Nice to have:
  • Associate Degree in Engineering or Construction Management or equivalent experience
  • 30-hour OSHA certification or willingness to obtain within 90 days
  • Estimating experience is a plus
  • VISTA project/accounting software experience a plus
What's in it for you?:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Short Term/Long Term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Health Savings Account
  • ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan)
  • 401K -match up to 4%
  • PTO
  • Six paid company holidays
